title: assurance-radar-ramon-2025
content:
Purpose: quick brain-dump for audit evidence gaps + lightweight control sketches. Not a polished plan — just my running notes while triaging items from the readiness spreadsheet and last week's trust sync.

Top-level questions (to resolve):
- Which config snapshots do we need for Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private? (per-customer vs global settings).
- Retention windows: what exact S3/GCS lifecycle rule dates are auditors expecting for logs? (30/90/365?)
- Do we have an enumerated list of privileged accounts and 90-day access reviews? I think engineering does quarterly but product infra is ad hoc.

Quick evidence map (sketch):
- Access controls: 1) IdP group exports (OKTA) -> export script + hash for proof. 2) Admin role change PRs (GitHub) -> link to PRs. 3) Privileged session logs -> (SPLUNK query id?)
- Change management: 1) Release tickets (Linear) + approvals -> collect list of 6 random releases. 2) Rollback/playbook snapshots -> store in /private-deployments/playbooks.
- Monitoring & incident response: 1) PagerDuty rotation schedule -> capture CSV + screenshot. 2) Postmortem templates filled (link to a couple anonymized examples).

Risks I keep bumping into:
- Shadow access: 3rd-party service accounts created by contractors not in OKTA groups. Need a monthly export of GCP service account list and owner tags.
- Evidence sprawl: we point auditors to different tools (S3, Drive, Confluence, GitHub). Need a single index file (evidence-index.csv) with canonical links and short descriptions.

Potential quick wins (low effort):
- Auto-generate an evidence-index by scripting metadata pulls (GitHub repo metadata, Okta group dumps, S3 object metadata). Build as a single CSV in Google Drive.
- Collect last 6 months of deployment PRs that touched infra/terraform and stash PDFs of the diffs.
- Standardize naming for playbooks: trust-playbook-<area>-vYYYYMMDD.md so auditors can see versioning.

Control mapping ideas (very rough):
- CC: Logical Access -> OKTA groups + MFA enforcement + Admin PR audits. Owner: @Maya. Evidence: okta_export_2026-02-01.csv, admin_prs_2026.pdf.
- CC: Change Mgmt -> Linear ticket approvals + Release notes + rollback test results. Owner: @DevOpsLead. Evidence: linear_closed_6.csv, release_notes_archive.zip.
- CC: System Monitoring -> Metrics dashboard screenshots + alert runbook existence. Owner: @SRE. Evidence: grafana_snapshot_2026-01-12.png, runbook_oncall.md.

Open action items (my next steps):
- [ ] Write a small Python notebook to pull Okta group membership + export to drive (deadline: 2025-11-10).
- [ ] Draft evidence-index template and share in #trust-ops for buy-in (deadline: 2025-11-14).
- [ ] Reach out to Finance for invoices retention policy to align log retention (P.O. BDR?).

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc lean; auditors hate noise. When collecting artifacts, add one-sentence context for each file (who generated it, why relevant).
- Anonymize customer data before uploading anything to shared drive.

References / quick links:
- Confluence: TRUST-OPS assurance playbook (internal) -> CONFLUENCE:TRUST-OPS/assurance-playbook-2025
- Linear epic: TRUST-42 (evidence collection)
- Slack channel: #trust-ops (pinned: evidence-index-template)

Random brain idea: create a tiny static site (index) that lists artifacts with statuses (collected/pending/under-review) — easier to hand to auditors than a dozen folders. Could host on private Redwood Pages.

End of dump. Will prune and convert to checklist for the onboarding doc next week.
